---
name: Feature request
about: Something the library should be able to do
labels: enhancement
---

**What you want to do**
The use case, not only the API you have in mind — e.g. "show a percentage
of the column total next to each value".

**How you work around it today**
Other tools, code outside the library, or nothing.

**Which layer**
The engine (`tessera`: sources, schema, cube, expressions, export), the
widgets (`tessera_flutter`), or one of the exporters. Skip this if you are
not sure.
